title: Part 4 — Talk 1: results briefing
instructionsVi: Ở mục tiêu 800, Part 4 có câu hỏi hàm ý: người nói nêu hai sự việc cạnh nhau và để người nghe tự nối.
promptEn: Listen to the briefing and answer questions 71 through 73.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Right, the customer survey. Two hundred and forty responses, our best return yet.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Satisfaction with the product is up two points. Satisfaction with support is down, and down most sharply among customers who have been with us longest.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We moved support onto the new ticketing system in March, and long-standing customers are precisely the ones who used to phone a named person. I'll leave you to join those two facts up.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: What I want from this meeting is a decision: restore a direct line for accounts over a certain size, or invest in making the ticket system faster for everyone.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Both cost money. Doing neither also costs money, just later, and to someone else's budget.

questions.prompt: 71. What is the overall trend in product satisfaction?
questions.explanationVi: 'Satisfaction with the product is up two points'. Cái GIẢM là hạng mục hỗ trợ.

questions.prompt: 72. What does the speaker imply by 'I'll leave you to join those two facts up'?

options.text: Long-standing customers are hard to please.
The new ticketing system is probably behind the drop.

questions.explanationVi: Hai sự việc đặt cạnh nhau: đổi hệ thống vào tháng Ba, và nhóm khách cũ vốn quen gọi thẳng một người.

questions.prompt: 73. What does the speaker mean about doing nothing?

options.text: It has a cost that appears later elsewhere.
It is not permitted by the board.

questions.explanationVi: 'Doing neither also costs money, just later, and to someone else's budget'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 2: voicemail about a claim
instructionsVi: Tin nhắn thoại có điều kiện lồng nhau và một mốc hạn. Bỏ một vế điều kiện là chọn sai.
promptEn: Listen to the telephone message and answer questions 74 through 76.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello Mr Kaya, this is Lena Fischer at Northline, returning your call about the rejected expense claim.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: The claim was declined because taxi fares aren't reimbursed where public transport runs on the route. That's the standard rule.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: However, there's an exception when no service was running, and from what you described, your flight landed after midnight. That exception wasn't recorded on the original claim, which is why it failed.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: If you resubmit with the flight arrival time shown, it will go through. The booking confirmation is enough — you don't need the boarding pass.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: One thing to watch: resubmit by the fifth to make this month's payment run. After that it rolls to next month, and I can't bring it forward.

questions.prompt: 74. Why was the claim originally declined?

options.text: It was submitted after the deadline.
Taxi fares are not reimbursed where public transport runs.

questions.explanationVi: 'taxi fares aren't reimbursed where public transport runs on the route'.

questions.prompt: 75. What must be included when resubmitting?
questions.explanationVi: 'resubmit with the flight arrival time shown… you don't need the boarding pass'.

questions.prompt: 76. What happens if the claim is resubmitted after the fifth?

options.text: It will be paid the following month.
It will need a new reference number.

questions.explanationVi: 'After that it rolls to next month, and I can't bring it forward'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 3: conference session introduction
instructionsVi: Bài giới thiệu. Có một chỗ đính chính chương trình in trên tài liệu.
promptEn: Listen to the introduction and answer questions 77 through 79.

transcript.speaker: Chair
transcript.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the second session of the supply chain forum.

transcript.speaker: Chair
transcript.text: A change to your programme: the panel on warehouse automation has swapped with the customs workshop, so automation is now at two and customs at half three. Your printed sheets show the old order.

transcript.speaker: Chair
transcript.text: Our panellists this afternoon are Dr Amina Sesay, who leads the supply chain group at Northfield, and Tomas Berg, who spent twelve years running distribution before moving into consultancy.

transcript.speaker: Chair
transcript.text: We'll take questions from the floor for the last twenty minutes. There are cards on each table if you'd rather write yours down — a steward will collect them during the session.

transcript.speaker: Chair
transcript.text: The recording will be available to delegates only, and not until the week after the conference.

questions.prompt: 77. What time is the automation panel now?
questions.explanationVi: 'automation is now at two and customs at half three'. Tài liệu in ra ghi thứ tự CŨ.

questions.prompt: 78. What did Mr Berg do before consultancy?

options.text: He led a university research group.

questions.explanationVi: 'spent twelve years running distribution before moving into consultancy'. Nhóm nghiên cứu đại học là của Dr Sesay.

questions.prompt: 79. What is said about the recording?

options.text: It is available to delegates a week later.
It will be published online immediately.
It can be purchased at the desk.

questions.explanationVi: 'available to delegates only, and not until the week after the conference'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 4: product recall notice
instructionsVi: Thông báo thu hồi. Chú ý phân biệt phạm vi áp dụng và điều được miễn.
promptEn: Listen to the announcement and answer questions 80 through 82.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: This is a customer safety announcement from Meridian regarding the TK-9 travel kettle.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Testing has identified a fault in a small number of units where the cut-off switch may not operate once the water boils. No injuries have been reported.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Because we cannot identify which individual units are affected, we are recalling the entire batch sold between January and April.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Please stop using the product and return it to any branch for a full refund. A receipt is not required — the serial number on the base is enough.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: If you bought the kettle as a gift, please pass this message on. Units bought after April are a different production run and are not affected.

questions.prompt: 80. Why is the whole batch being recalled?

options.text: The affected units cannot be identified individually.

questions.explanationVi: 'Because we cannot identify which individual units are affected'. Bài nói rõ chỉ một số ít bị lỗi và chưa có thương tích.

questions.prompt: 81. What is needed for a refund?

options.text: The serial number on the base

questions.explanationVi: 'A receipt is not required — the serial number on the base is enough'.
'Units bought after April are a different production run and are not affected'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 5: automated banking line
instructionsVi: Tổng đài tự động có một hướng dẫn phủ định quan trọng nằm giữa danh sách lựa chọn.
promptEn: Listen to the recorded message and answer questions 83 through 85.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Fairport Business Banking. Please listen carefully as our menu has changed.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: For balance and transactions, press one. To make a payment, press two. For lending and overdrafts, press three.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: If you are calling to report suspected fraud, do not use the menu. Stay on the line and you will be connected directly to our security team, who are available twenty-four hours.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Please note that we will never ask you to confirm a full password or move money to a safe account. Anyone doing so is not from this bank.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Calls are recorded. Wait times are currently longer than usual on weekday mornings.

questions.prompt: 83. What should a caller reporting fraud do?

options.text: Stay on the line without using the menu

questions.explanationVi: 'do not use the menu. Stay on the line'. Câu phủ định đứng giữa danh sách lựa chọn, rất dễ bỏ qua.

questions.prompt: 84. What does the bank say it will never do?

options.text: Connect callers to the security team
Ask for a full password or to move money

questions.explanationVi: 'we will never ask you to confirm a full password or move money to a safe account'.

options.text: Wait times are always the same.

questions.explanationVi: 'Wait times are currently longer than usual on weekday mornings'.
